item.description: Master Gardeners, from left, Pam Kelley, Honey Niemann and Mary Larson weed and clean up the Minnie Nakano pocket park on Sims Way and 10th Street in Port Townsend on Wednesday. The trio were trying to beat a rainstorm coming in later in the afternoon.
